translations.web: For we all stumble in many things. Anyone who doesn’t stumble in word is a perfect person, able to bridle the whole body also.
translations.bsb: We all stumble in many ways. If anyone is never at fault in what he says, he is a perfect man, able to control his whole body.
translations.kjv: For in many things we offend all. If any man offend not in word, the same is a perfect man, and able also to bridle the whole body.
translations.asv: For in many things we all stumble. If any stumbleth not in word, the same is a perfect man, able to bridle the whole body also.
